result:
I'd make it so people can't unsee the consequences of their actions.

Not just know about them intellectually, but actually feel the weight of how their words, choices, and inactions land on other people in real time. The kind of instant, undeniable feedback that makes cruelty, indifference and exploitation feel as unnatural and painful as it is to the person on the receiving end.

If everyone had that, most of the rest of the problems in the world would start to solve themselves.
